purpose: Synthetic diagnostic checks of request-to-surviving-incremental-change targeting; not an independent human real-world audit, precision estimate, retrieval evaluation or proof of causal influence.
label_provenance: Constructed expectations declared by the architecture reviewer before any model outputs. No paid calls have been run.
offset_units: Python Unicode code points; half-open [start,end) offsets into the exact adjacent source field.

interpretation.true: The request supports the specific incremental surviving effect in the supplied context.
interpretation.false: It does not support that effect, or the selected target is structurally ineligible.
interpretation.unknown: Supplied evidence cannot establish the incremental relation; report uncertainty separately, not as a calibrated correctness label.
interpretation.expected_request_skip: Structural target cases must be skipped before a model request. Empty target spans are intentional only in the pure-deletion guard case.

execution_plan.stage: Validate targets with actual adopt_records; create request manifest without calling provider; freeze fixture+manifest hashes; request explicit budget approval before external evaluation.
execution_plan.retrieval: The direct target diagnostic bypasses BM25; candidate retrieval recall is not measured.
execution_plan.comparison: Run legacy whole-amendment and new surviving-target prompts on the same non-skip cases; their task difference is explicit. Do not reuse new labels as proof the old broader question is incorrect.
execution_plan.reporting: Report all cases, raw answer dimensions, accepted/skipped/missing/uncertain outcomes and costs; aggregate counts are diagnostic only. Keep challenge categories and structural skips separate.
